sources.title: Run Gemma 4 on iPhone 17 with Google AI Edge Gallery
sources.snippet: Run Gemma 4 on iPhone 17 with Google AI Edge Gallery The standard iPhone 17 brings Apple's A19 chip and 8 GB of RAM to a non-Pro device for the first time. That combination handles Google Gemma 4 E2B effortlessly through Google AI Edge Gallery, with estimated speeds north of 35 tokens per second. The larger E4B model technically runs but eats most of your memory budget, so close other apps ...
